title: Tangokalender site config (site.toml)
description: Settings for one city's calendar site, kept as site.toml at the root of its data repo.

slug.description: Short id of the site, e.g. oslo.

name.description: Site name in titles, feeds and previews, e.g. «Tangokalender | Oslo».

city.description: The city: default venue city, texts and geocoding.

site_url.description: Where the site is published (may include a path), e.g. https://tangokalender.github.io/bergen.

repo_url.description: The data repo with the issue forms.

og_image.description: Link-preview image (1200×630 PNG), relative to site.toml. Default: the package's generic image.

center.description: [lat, lon] shown when no event has a position.

viewbox.description: Nominatim viewbox lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2 to prefer results in the city.

texts.description: UI strings that replace the package's defaults, per language, keyed like src/i18n.jl (_T), e.g. site.tagline.
